attr.title: MidBoss
attr.desc: Kill your enemies, possess their bodies, and take their abilities to become the ultimate dungeon boss in this tactical roguelike.
attr.inst: Place your purchased MidBoss Linux binary (MidBoss-Linux-142-bin) into the 'midboss/gamedata' folder. The port will automatically extract and configure the game on first launch.
attr.inst_md:
1. Purchase MidBoss from [itch.io](https://kitsunegames.itch.io/midboss) or [Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/561740/MidBoss/).
2. Place `MidBoss-Linux-142-bin` (or extracted game files) into `ports/midboss/gamedata/`.
3. Launch **MidBoss** from PortMaster to auto-extract and play!
